entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
I'm very sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or perhaps a preference?
It's a technical fault. It's broken.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. I see you received it about 12 days ago. Can you describe what's happening when you try to use it?
It won't sync. I've followed all the steps in the app and it just doesn't connect to my phone. It's useless.
I understand how frustrating that must be. So the device powers on, but the core issue is that it won't sync with the VeloFit app on your phone, is that right?

I appreciate the confirmation. Since the device is powering on but having a connection issue, it sounds like something our Technical Support team can best assist with. They have specialized tools to troubleshoot syncing problems and can determine if the unit is actually defective and needs a replacement. I can transfer you directly to them now.
Fine. I guess I have to talk to someone else now. Whatever.
I'm confident they're the right team to get this resolved for you quickly. I will connect you right away. Is there anything else I can assist with before I make the transfer?
Alright. Please hold one moment while I connect you to our Tech Support department.
